critical_code_review_comments: manufacturing_dashboard.py loads ALL products (.to_list(500)) and re-inspects each on every request; identical to iteration_29 note. As product count grows past 500 the .to_list cap will silently truncate — consider paginating and/or memoizing quality_scores from /inspection/summary (they're computed identically and cross-verified in tests).

connector_health list literally re-shapes cx.list_connectors() output; if connector count changes the frontend hard-checks 23 rows implicitly. Adding a 'total' field alongside the list would future-proof consumers.

Revenue provenance logic is `TEST if STRIPE_TEST else (LIVE if paid else NOT_TRACKED)`. This is fine but means once Stripe flips to live keys with 0 orders the value will still be $0 with LIVE label — consider `LIVE if paid else NOT_TRACKED` regardless (or a 'ready but no orders yet' label).
Alerts list has no ID/key on each alert; frontend uses index key which is OK for now but stable IDs would help selective dismissal later.
Dashboard route lacks role-based restriction; any authenticated user can view founder-level factory numbers. If desired, gate to super_admin/founder like other Command routes.
